suite: Corrected pending two-input OnityTask.WhenAll lifecycle, first call, and 384-outstanding burst
workingFileNote: The runner and configuration Git blobs match across hosts. Working-file SHA-256 differs because checkout line endings differ; each host used its unchanged working file for timing and allocation processes.

processes.reportStaging: Output written outside both Unity project roots; generated JSON/CSV/Markdown copied unchanged to docs/assets/benchmarks.

faultCorrection: PrepareBatch constructs one new InvalidOperationException per operation and per library before the measured slice. No exception instance is reused across operations, batches, or processes.

scope.lifecycle: WhenAll scheduling, pending input completion, output GetResult, cleanup; input source and exception construction excluded.
scope.mainProfiler: Nested GC.Alloc samples under the main-thread marker only; worker tracker continuations excluded.
scope.allThreadDiagnostic: Time-bounded GC.Alloc window across Profiler threads, including a tracked-batch completion barrier. Raw totals include harness barrier and any unrelated allocations inside the window; exclusive tracker attribution is not established.
scope.firstCall: One first observed pending call after warmed Editor startup and Profiler calibration, before harness WhenAll warmup; one sample per allocation process.
scope.burst: 384 pending outputs scheduled before any input completion, tracker off; input construction and completion outside marker. Candidate coordinator pool cap is 256.

controls.baselineRepeatAllThreadStatus: UNAVAILABLE: ThreadPool positive control captured 65,602 B on other threads and 88 B on main; all its all-thread samples were discarded.
controls.directWorkerStatus: UNAVAILABLE: GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread failed its 64 KiB positive control; never interpret zero as measured worker allocation.

historicalV4Data: The four v4 reports retain valid pending scheduling and completed-input controls. Their fault rows are invalid because one exception was reused and are not combined with v5 data.
discardedOrLimitedRuns: First v5 baseline timing process completed but Unity cleaned JSON/CSV written under its project Temp directory; only its log/Markdown survived. Repeated outside-project timing process is the accepted first baseline report.
Baseline repeat all-thread Profiler window rejected by its ThreadPool positive control. Its main-thread, first-call, burst, timing, and raw fault rows remain valid.
Three unrelated Unity 6000.5.6f1 Coin processes persisted. No Unity 2022.3.62f3 Editor or Player overlap occurred during retained processes.
limitations: Editor/Mono microbenchmark only; no Player/IL2CPP, frame-time, device, or whole-scene result. First-call has two process samples per host, not eight independently cold processes. Accepted all-thread windows are diagnostics with one valid baseline process and two candidate processes.
